note: Market inputs shared by every company. The engine hard-codes none of these. Values are decimals unless stated. Raw files are listed in data/manifest/market_sources.csv.

risk_free.method: mean of month-end FBIL 10-year par yields over the last 12 months
risk_free.label: CALCULATION from FACTs
risk_free.source: FBIL 'GOI Prices including Par Yield' files, sheet 'Par Yield', column B (YTM % p.a., semi-annual); the engine reads each file and checks its printed date
risk_free.note: The last business day of each month on FBIL's archive (30 March 2026, not 31 March). Averaging smooths the rate, but it is a different date basis from the spot price and the July 2026 ERP; the spot yield is reported beside it. Par yield over a single bond, and the July ERP, confirmed by the author (2026-10-15).

default_spread.label: ASSUMPTION
default_spread.source: Damodaran, Country and Equity Risk Premiums, July 2026 update (market/erp/Damodaran_2026-07-01_country-risk-premiums.xlsx, sheet 'ERPs by country', row 73: India, Baa3, rating-based default spread 1.7499%)
default_spread.note: Removed from the G-sec yield to get a default-free INR rate, so India's default risk is not counted twice (Damodaran's convention). UNCERTAIN: the file's 'Date of update' cell reads 30 June 2022 (Excel serial 44742) while the same row says 'Default spreads corrected on July 9, 2026' and the file is named ctrypremJuly26: probably a stale cell.

erp.label: ASSUMPTION
erp.source: Damodaran, same file and row: India total equity risk premium 6.9202% (mature market 4.20% + country risk premium 2.72%)
erp.note: July 2026 update chosen over the January 2026 page (7.08%).
